description: Built has finally released the Pink Lemonade Squeeze Sour Puff and it is a complete refresh for anyone who is tired of the same old protein bar flavors. If you are looking for a snack that provides a sharp and zesty citrus kick then this is definitely the one for you. One of my favorite features is the light and fluffy marshmallow consistency that makes every bite feel like a treat rather than a workout supplement. I love how it delivers 16 grams of high-quality protein and collagen while maintaining a low-calorie count of only 150 calories per bar. Why I like this product so much is the sweet white coating and those little sugar sprinkles on top that give it a perfect texture. It is a great gluten-free option for a mid-afternoon energy boost that hits that sour craving without ruining your diet. #Built #PinkLemonadeSqueeze #SourPuff #TikTokShopSpringGlowUp #Greenish
